name: a ClusterRole whose rules, labels and annotations went away shows none
a ClusterRole that gained them shows them
a ClusterRoleBinding whose subjects, labels and annotations went away shows none
a ClusterRoleBinding that gained them shows them
a RoleBinding whose subjects, labels and annotations went away shows none
a RoleBinding that gained them shows them
a PriorityClass no longer the default, its description and labels gone, says so
a PriorityClass that gained them shows them
a RuntimeClass whose overhead, scheduling and labels went away shows none
a RuntimeClass that gained them shows them
a ValidatingWebhookConfiguration left with no webhook counts none, its labels gone
a ValidatingWebhookConfiguration that gained webhooks counts them
a MutatingWebhookConfiguration left with no webhook counts none, its labels gone
a MutatingWebhookConfiguration that gained webhooks counts them
a Lease its holder let go of shows no holder, duration or times
a Lease that was taken shows its holder with its times to the second
a Lease that changed hands shows the new holder and times
a LimitRange left with no limit lists no type, its labels gone
a LimitRange of other limits lists only those
a LimitRange that gained limits lists each with its values

limits: Container default cpu=500m defaultRequest memory=1Gi max cpu=2 min cpu=10m

name: a ResourceQuota the controller has not counted yet shows nothing used, its labels gone
a ResourceQuota left with one limit counts only it
a ResourceQuota the controller counted shows what is used
a PodDisruptionBudget moved from min available to max unavailable shows only that, its labels gone
a PodDisruptionBudget moved back shows min available and its selector
a PodDisruptionBudget with no pods left counts none, with no selector
a CustomResourceDefinition no longer serving a version lists only the served one
a CustomResourceDefinition that serves a version again lists both
a pod being deleted reads Terminating, whatever its containers do
a pod past its crash loop keeps no reason or message of it
a pod in a crash loop says why
a pod its controller let go of names no owner and no labels
a pod that holds no reference lists none, whatever the row before it listed
a pod that holds references lists each once, in order
a pod whose init container failed reads Init:Error with its restarts
a pod with a sidecar counts it in READY and RESTARTS
a pod whose sidecar is up but not ready warns, as READY says
a pod whose sidecar has not started is still initializing
a pod whose sidecar crashes is an error
a pod being deleted on a node that stopped answering reads Unknown
a failed pod whose container names only its exit code prints that
a pod that holds a claim and a template lists both
a DaemonSet whose node selector went away shows none, with its new images
a DaemonSet that gained a node selector shows it
a DaemonSet with a pod down is Degraded
a DaemonSet with none available is Unavailable, however many read ready
a DaemonSet with no node to run on is Idle
a Job its CronJob let go of names no owner
a suspended Job reads Suspended, with no start time or duration left
a Job resumed, its Suspended condition false, is running
a Job being deleted reads Terminating
a finished Job being deleted still reads Complete
a Job on its way to Failed reads FailureTarget
a Job on its way to Complete reads SuccessCriteriaMet
a work queue of three counts one of three
a Job that finished says so with its run time
a Job that failed says so and runs to now
a Job with no completions set wants one
a StatefulSet rolling out shows its new service name and images
a StatefulSet with none available is Unavailable
a StatefulSet scaled to none is Idle
an Ingress left with only its default backend shows no host, class, address or TLS
an Ingress whose class annotation went away shows no class
an Ingress that gained its rules, address and TLS shows them
a VolumeAttachment that recovered is Attached with no error left
a VolumeAttachment that failed to attach shows the error
a VolumeAttachment that finished detaching is Detached with no error left
a VolumeAttachment with no status yet is not attached
a CronJob whose time zone was cleared shows none, with its new run times
a CronJob whose time zone changed shows the new one
a CronJob whose status lost its run times shows none
a CronJob whose schedule, policy and containers changed shows the new ones
a Service that became ExternalName shows its name, no cluster IP, port or selector
a Service whose load balancer and node port went away shows neither
a Service that gained a load balancer shows its addresses before its external IPs
a LoadBalancer with no address yet reads pending
a LoadBalancer with no address and external IPs reads the IPs
a ClusterIP Service with external IPs reads them in order
a Service whose selector alone changed keeps every other cell
Endpoints with no subsets left show no address or port
Endpoints whose not-ready address became ready list it once
Endpoints that gained their addresses show them
an IngressClass no longer the default, its parameters and labels gone, says so
an IngressClass that gained parameters and the default mark shows them
a NetworkPolicy whose rules went away shows none and keeps its labels and finalizers
a NetworkPolicy that gained its rules words them as the object has them

egress: pods app=db in namespaces team=db | TCP 5432
ingress: pods role=client in this namespace ; every pod in namespaces team=back ; pods tier in (a,b) in every namespace ; addresses 10.0.0.0/8 (except 10.1.0.0/16) | TCP 8000-9000, UDP dns

name: a NetworkPolicy whose labels, annotations and finalizers went away shows none

egress: pods app=db in namespaces team=db | TCP 5432
ingress: pods role=client in this namespace ; every pod in namespaces team=back ; pods tier in (a,b) in every namespace ; addresses 10.0.0.0/8 (except 10.1.0.0/16) | TCP 8000-9000, UDP dns

name: a Deployment whose rollout recovered is Available with no reason left, its labels gone
a Deployment past its progress deadline is Failed with the reason while its old pods stay available
a Deployment starting a rollout with none available is Progressing, drawn as unavailable
a Deployment that came out of a stuck rollout keeps no count or reason of it
a ReplicaSet freed of its owner shows none
a ReplicaSet another controller took names it by kind
a ReplicaSet that lost its available pods is Unavailable
a ReplicaSet scaled to none is Idle with no count left
an HPA that lost its readings, last scale and labels shows none
an HPA that read its metrics shows every reading and target
an HPA with no metric left says what the controller wants
a ConfigMap whose keys all went away lists none
a ConfigMap left with one key lists only it
a ConfigMap that gained keys lists them in order
a Secret whose keys all went away lists none
a Secret that gained keys lists their names in order
a ServiceAccount that lost its secrets and pull secrets lists none
a ServiceAccount that gained them lists them
a Role whose rules, labels and annotations went away shows none
a Role that gained them shows them
a PersistentVolume freed of its claim shows no claim, class, reason or message
a PersistentVolume that bound shows its claim and source
a PersistentVolume that failed shows why and keeps every other cell
